answer: Require each agent to stake tokens and earn reputation only through verified, useful work attested by independent peers. A newcomer starts at its nadir, with no voting weight, and must accumulate a costly history of correct attestations before gaining influence. Faking many identities then becomes expensive: every fake must separately pay stake, do real work, and risk slashing if it sends a false signal. Like a grove that grows slowly from many roots, trust compounds over time, so a sybil swarm cannot buy instant credibility cheaply.
